title: fix(data-objectstack,app-shell): one meta/view read per open: a settled view list that refresh and every console view write drop (objectui#13057)
body:
Fixes #13057
Clause-②: no

## What changes

One object-page open now reads `GET /api/v1/meta/view` **once** (was 3 before objectui#13044, 2 after PR #13053). This completes objectui#13044 ruling `6268839381` (a) to (c).

**The adapter keeps a settled list** (`@object-ui/data-objectstack`).
- `MetadataCache.share` still joins a request in flight and is never answered from a settled entry. It now also **stores** its landing. A request detached by `invalidate` / `clear` still stores nothing.
- The client wrap (`installViewListShare`) is unchanged otherwise. A caller of `getClient().meta.getItems('view')` (the provider's eager read) always asks the server, and its answer is stored under `list:view`.
- `readViewList` (the source for `listViews` and `listViewOverrides`) answers from the stored list while it holds one. Otherwise it reads through the client wrap. Every caller gets its own `structuredClone`.

**Every path that should see a fresh list drops it first.**
- (a) **User refresh.** `ObjectView`'s `refreshData` calls `dropPublishedViewList(dataSource)` before it bumps the counter. The saved-views read it re-runs asks the server again. That covers realtime, server actions, imports and the refresh action. Provider re-reads (`refresh('view')`) go through the client, so they always ask.
- (b) **Every in-SPA view write.**
  - The adapter seam (`invalidateViewKeys`) and the adapter's client write wrap already dropped the key. Now that the key holds a settled list, they drop it.
  - **New: the console `MetadataClient`.** `useMetadataClient` (the hook every app-shell write path takes its client from, as it does for the advisory sink) wraps the client's write doors through `installViewListDrop` (`views/metadata-admin/viewListDrop.ts`). Each `save` / `publish` / `publishDraft` / `reset` / `rollback` whose type is `view`, and each `publishPackageDrafts`, drops the list once the write settles, whether it landed or was refused. It drops through the adapter's existing public `invalidateCache(key)`.
  - **Why an explicit drop and not the pulse.** The metadata-refresh pulse does reach the adapter (the provider's `clearCache`). It also re-reads every loaded provider type, so firing it on every Studio draft autosave would be a refetch storm. Package-wide publishes get both.
- **`PackagesPage` `publishDrafts`** now calls `emitMetadataRefresh()` after a 2xx batch, as Studio's publish-all, Home's and the chat bar's do. It is sent before the `failed[]` verdict, as Studio sends it.
- (c) **Org or session switch.** Unchanged: `MetadataProvider` `dropAdapterWorld` clears the whole adapter cache. It now has a settled-list pin.

**No new export, no new public member.** `MetadataCache` is package-internal. `viewListDrop.ts` is module-internal: no barrel re-exports it, and `metadata-admin/index.ts` and the package `index.ts` are untouched. The one cross-package spelling is the key literal `list:view` in `viewListDrop.ts`. The provider and refresh pins drive a real adapter, so if the key is renamed they go red.

## The writers, enumerated (and pinned so a new one cannot be silent)

The enumeration is pinned at the door, not by call-site list. Every console `MetadataClient` is built by `useMetadataClient`: the provider's draft-preview client is the read-only exception, and `new MetadataClient(` was already ratcheted. Every door of `MetadataClient` that sends a write is wrapped.

- `viewListDrop-13057.test.tsx` derives the write doors from `MetadataClient.prototype`: every method whose comment-masked body calls `this.sendWrite(`. It asserts that set equals `ITEM_WRITE_DOORS` plus `PACKAGE_WRITE_DOORS`.
- The same file scans app-shell `src` (comment-masked with `scripts/js-comment-mask.mjs`) for `createConsoleMetadataClient(` call sites. It asserts they are exactly the hook and `MetadataProvider`.

Call sites under `views/metadata-admin/**` and `views/studio-design/**` that can write a `view` row, from a grep of the write doors:
- `ResourceEditPage`: create (`save`, live or draft), the guarded draft `save`, `publish`, `reset` (delete/reset and discard draft). The type is generic, so `view` included.
- `ResourceHistoryPage`: `rollback`, generic type.
- `EmbeddedItemEditor`: `save(parentType, …)`.
- `DraftConflictDialog`: the guarded `save` used by `ResourceEditPage` and Studio's `ObjectListViewInspector` (view drafts).
- `PackagesPage` and `StudioDesignSurface`: `publishPackageDrafts`. Studio also has `publishDraft('flow', …)` and typed saves.

The other writes in those directories are typed `object` / `hook` / `flow` / `permission`, and they keep the list (control pin). All of these take their client from `useMetadataClient`.

## Pins

- (a) `MetadataProvider.oneMetadataRead-13044.test.tsx`: the console order (eager read, then `listViews` plus `listViewOverrides`, plus a second overrides read) is **1** request (was 2). The comment in the test gives the reason.
- (a) The same file: within an open, later `listViews` reads are settled. A provider `refresh('view')` asks again, and the next list read sees what that refresh read (a row added server-side appears only after it).
- (b) `ObjectView.refreshRereadsViews-13057.test.tsx` uses the real page, a real adapter and a realtime refresh. The open reads once; `refreshData` re-asks (1 then 2). Control: a re-render with no refresh reads nothing.
- (c) `viewListDrop-13057.test.tsx` has one leg per writer class: save (draft), save (live), publish, publishDraft, reset, rollback, publishPackageDrafts. Each leg settles the list, writes, then the next read re-asks exactly once. A refused view write drops it too. Controls: a write of another type keeps the list, the write's answer passes through untouched, and with no adapter in context the writes still land.
- (c) `oneMetadataRead`: `invalidateViewKeys`, and a `saveItem('view')` straight through the adapter's client, each drop the settled list.
- (d) `PackagesPage.publishPulse-13057.test.tsx` uses the real sheet and `useMetadataClient`. *Publish app* emits the pulse once, and the next `listViews` re-asks. A batch answered with `failed[]` still emits it.
- (e) CONTROLS:
  - `MetadataProvider.switchDropsAdapter-13044.test.tsx`: an org switch and a session switch each re-ask after a settled read.
  - `oneMetadataRead`: a draft-preview `listViews` is its own `?preview=draft` request and never fills `list:view` (`getCached('list:view')` stays undefined, and the published read still asks once).
- `viewCacheInvalidation.pin.test.ts` stays truthful: `listViews` consults exactly `list:view` (settled within an open), else the transport, and no per-object key. Its header says the named writers drop it.
- `MetadataCache.share-13044.test.ts`: `share` is never answered from a settled entry and stores its landing. A request detached by `invalidate` stores nothing.

## Ablations

Each was run through `ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor must hit; restore proven by blob hash equal to HEAD and an empty `git diff HEAD`). The subject resolves through the vitest alias to `src/`, so no dist build was involved.

| # | mutation | went red | restore (blob = HEAD) |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `readViewList`: drop the settled read (`if (settled !== undefined) return …` replaced with `void settled;`) | (a) console order `expected 2 to be 1`, plus the two settled legs | `index.ts` 9ef65591060b |
| 2 | `installViewListDrop`: the package door without `.finally(drop)` | the `publishPackageDrafts` leg (`expected 1 to be 2`) and (d)'s re-read leg; the other 6 writer legs stayed green | `viewListDrop.ts` 286c0f6df1fa |
| 3 | `installViewListDrop`: the item doors without the view drop | all 6 item-writer legs plus the refused-write leg; the package leg and the controls stayed green | `viewListDrop.ts` 286c0f6df1fa |
| 4 | `refreshData` without `dropPublishedViewList` | (b) `expected 1 to be 2` | `ObjectView.tsx` 6cc2e5cc98d1 |
| 5 | `publishDrafts` without `emitMetadataRefresh()` | both (d) legs `expected +0 to be 1` | `PackagesPage.tsx` 98ee9953967f |

## Gates

The numbers below are for head `ca09edc959`. Each exit code was captured before any pipe.

- Type-check: closure built first (`turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'`, 28/28).
  - `@object-ui/data-objectstack` `type-check`: 0. Its `--listFiles` includes both edited tests.
  - `@object-ui/app-shell` `type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): 0. `--listFiles` includes all five new or edited app-shell tests.
- Targeted vitest (`--maxWorkers=1`, under the verify lock): the 7 new or edited files, then the families of the touched files, all green.
  - The family set is every data-objectstack test that reads the view list or `MetadataCache`, every `ObjectView*` test, every `PackagesPage*` and `MetadataProvider*` test, and every app-shell test importing `metadata-admin/useMetadata`, which takes in 129 studio-design files.
  - That is 265 files run in 7 chunks, 0 failures.
- `pnpm lint`, narrowed to the 13 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files: 0 errors.
  - The 13 files come from eslint's own `--format json` output.
  - `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware, and this diff cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
  - The new warnings are the two react-hooks ref warnings beside the existing `tRef` ones in `useMetadataClient`.
- Pre-tsc battery, all 0: `check:phantom-deps`, `self-import`, `unreferenced-sources`, `doc-example-readers`, `handler-key-reads`, `side-effects-array`, `element-data-source-declaration`, `spec-symbols`, `action-forward-parity`, `designer-field-key-parity`, `icon-record-names`, `i18n-keys`, `i18n-drift`, `i18n-designer-parity`, `control-bytes`, `scripts/check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`. Also `check:test-path-roots` and `check:new-line-citations`: 0.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-fixed.mjs`: 0. `check-changeset-presence`: one changeset declared, `.changeset/13057-settled-view-list.md` (`patch` for both packages).
- NOT MEASURED: `check:spec-floors`. It exits 1 with `no-artifact`, because it needs the whole workspace built; that is not a verdict on this diff.
- NOT MEASURED: the full `packages/app-shell/` and `packages/data-objectstack/` directories. They are declared to CI per the dispatch (no whole-package runs on the shared box).

## Acceptance notes (seen, not filed: static reading, no public-door reproduction)

- The other `PackagesPage` lifecycle actions emit no metadata-refresh pulse either: registry publish, revert, delete, enable/disable and adopt-orphans all go through `apiJson`. Each can change live metadata, views included. Ruling 4 named only `publishDrafts`. Carrier: none.
- A console `MetadataClient` view write drops `list:view`, but not the adapter's per-object `view-overrides:OBJECT` / `view:OBJECT:NAME` entries. Those need the object name, which `reset` / `rollback` / `publish` do not carry. This was already the case before this PR, and the stored override map can stay stale for the cache TTL after a metadata-admin view publish. Carrier: none.
